title: Bib
description: Our bibs are made of pure cellulose combined with one polyethylene sheet. Highly absorbent, waterproof, tear-resistant, ideal for different uses in the medical and dental sectors. Medical napkins are a disposable product for medical and dental studios.
excerpt: Our bibs are made of pure cellulose combined with one polyethylene sheet.

title: Bibs(roll)
description: These products are dental bibs designed and realized by Dispotech to protect patients from contaminations during dental operations and procedures. They are highly absorbent dental bibs in tear-off rolls, made of cellulose and polyethylene. Dental bibs are disposable products, designed for dental and medical studios: soft and easy to use, they are produced for the maximum comfort of the patient, giving at the same time the best protection against stains and sprays. We can sum up the main characteristics of our dental disposable bibs as follows: They ensure durable patient protection due to high absorption They are ideal for cleanings and minor procedures They are easy to be disposed of
excerpt: These products are dental bibs designed and realized by Dispotech to protect patients from contaminations during dental operations and procedures.

title: Disposable tray paper
description: Our crinkled dental tray paper, permeable to steam and gas, with no chloride and dioxin. Tray paper is the ideal base for the aluminium trays commonly used in medical and dental studios worldwide. The product is realised with high quality materials and boasts great resistance. it is designed to withstand autoclave sterilisation cycles. Advantages: Highly resistant and absorbent Are used as a protection either in reusable trays or on articulated shelves Prevent cross-contamination and water seepage to the tray surface Are easy to be disposed of
excerpt: Our crinkled dental tray paper, permeable to steam and gas, with no chloride and dioxin.

title: Saliva ejector (suction tip)
description: Our saliva ejector is made of transparent, atoxic PVC: clean, easy to use and designed for the best comfort. They are flexible and have a metal thread incorporated to maintain the angle set. Equipped with removable, rounded cap, the ejector is ideal to use for operations where the mucous membrane is irritated.
excerpt: Our saliva ejector is made of transparent, atoxic PVC: clean, easy to use and designed for the best comfort.

title: Disposable cups
description: Our disposable cups are made of polypropylene, that is a very resistant, high quality material which prevents them from breaking, even if they are squashed. The cups are light and resistant, easy to store and dispose of and are the perfect choice for the dental sector. Disposable cups have curved edges that make them comfortable and pleasant to use; They are designed to leave no residue when used, and are 100% recyclable. Our disposable cups are available in a wide range of brilliant colours, ideal to add a relaxing touch to any studio.
excerpt: Our disposable cups are made of polypropylene, that is a very resistant, high quality material which prevents them from breaking, even if they are squashed.

title: Ortho box
description: Ortho box is a practical, functional denture box to carry orthodontic braces, bites or functional brackets around in. The ortho box is ideal to gain the utmost hygiene when storing and transporting orthodontic braces. Our ortho box is realized in non-toxic, highly resistant and long-lasting plastic. The materials have been chosen to guarantee a high-quality ortho box and provide a long life product that maintains good performances over time.
excerpt: Ortho box is a practical, functional denture box to carry orthodontic braces, bites or functional brackets around in.

title: Micro applicator
description: Our micro applicator is a kind of dental applicator which is highly resistant and non-absorbent. The main features of this dental applicator is its compact size and its bendable plastic handle that allows a precise and localised. Due to its shape and outstanding professional edges, Perfecto dental applicator improves workflow at your dental health practice. It is optimized for succinct applications and guarantee a healthier and virus-free environment. Being disposable, this dental applicator by Dispotech guarantees the utmost hygiene and safe contact with patients’ gums avoiding the presence of bacteria and other elements that might cause infections.
excerpt: Our micro applicator is a kind of dental applicator which is highly resistant and non-absorbent.

title: Dental cotton roll
description: Our rolls are disposable dental cotton rolls in pure, non chlorinated, long fibre cotton (fibre length 11-13 mm). They are highly absorbent (over 20g/g) and do not dissolve in water. Their fusion point is at 400°C. They are soft and comfortable, they easily fit the patient's anatomy for a swift use.
excerpt: Our rolls are disposable dental cotton rolls in pure, non chlorinated, long fibre cotton (fibre length 11-13 mm).

title: Syringe applicator tips
description: These products are ideal for the precise application of gels. The product is available in two different versions.
excerpt: These products are ideal for the precise application of gels.

title: Disposable headrest cover
description: Our headrest over are the perfect solution to protect your dental chair with style. They are manufactured with a two-layered process: The top layer is made of premium cellulose (26 g/m²), while the bottom layer is made of polyethylene (PE) for maximum protection against water.
excerpt: Our headrest over are the perfect solution to protect your dental chair with style.

title: Disposable bed sheets
description: These products are pre-coated, precut medical disposable sheets. Due to the materials they are made of, they ensure high tearing strength and perfect waterproofness. As a matter of fact, our disposable sheets are composed of one ply of absorbent tissue and one ply of waterproof polyethylene.
excerpt: These products are pre-coated, precut medical disposable sheets.

title: Disposable mop cap
description: Our disposable cap provided with elastic, to perfectly fit any head size. The cap is made in TNT12g/m2, and is ideal to gather a patient or operator's hair to prevent it from falling down and spreading germs from the hair or scalp from contaminating the environment. As a matter of fact, as these caps are simply disposed of after use, they help keep the highest level of higyene.
excerpt: Our disposable cap provided with elastic, to perfectly fit any head size.

title: 3 Layer disposable medical face mask
description: This product is equipped with 3 layers of built-in filtration, These disposable face masks use layers of nonwoven fibers to shield the mouth, nose, and chin. These earloop masks include a flexible nose wire and two elastic earloops for a customizable fit and easy mobility during use.
excerpt: This product is equipped with 3 layers of built-in filtration, These disposable face masks use layers of nonwoven fibers to shield the mouth, nose, and chin.

title: Plexiglass bib dispenser
description: In the pursuit of impeccable hygiene and seamless organization, our Transparent Plexiglass Bib Dispenser takes center stage in dental practices. Crafted from high-quality plexiglass, this dispenser is designed to not only store but also facilitate the extraction of bibs with its central slot, making it an essential tool for dental offices, clinics, and healthcare settings. Key Features: Transparency: The transparent plexiglass construction of this bib dispenser ensures that you have a clear view of the remaining bibs. You'll always know when it's time for a refill, saving you time and hassle. Effortless Extraction: Featuring a central slot, our dispenser takes the hassle out of accessing bibs. Simply pull the bib through the slot, and it's ready for use, ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow. Hygienic Excellence: Maintaining a sterile environment is paramount in dental practices. This dispenser's design minimizes the risk of contamination, allowing for touch-free bib extraction, reducing the potential for cross-contamination. Space-Saving Design: With its wall-mounted configuration, our bib dispenser optimizes your dental workspace by keeping bibs easily accessible yet out of the way. Durable and Dependable: Crafted from robust plexiglass, this dispenser is built to last. It can withstand the rigors of daily use while maintaining its pristine appearance. Why Choose Our Transparent Plexiglass Bib Dispenser for Dental Practices: Enhanced Hygiene: Prioritize patient safety and infection control with touch-free bib extraction. Efficiency at Its Best: Enjoy a streamlined workflow with central slot convenience. Optimized Dental Workspace: Free up valuable counter space while keeping bibs within arm's reach. Durability You Can Trust: Invest in a dispenser that stands the test of time. Peace of Mind: Always know when it's time for a bib refill with transparent visibility. Upgrade your dental practice today with our Transparent Plexiglass Bib Dispenser. Prioritize hygiene, efficiency, and professionalism in patient care, all while creating a clean and welcoming atmosphere for your dental patients.
excerpt: In the pursuit of impeccable hygiene and seamless organization, our Transparent Plexiglass Bib Dispenser takes center stage in dental practices.

title: Denture box
description: Our denture Box is a denture container and prosthesis holder that assures perfect cleaning for all kinds of prostheses and braces. The denture container can be used to store denture prostheses and bites with the maximum hygiene, in water with denture cleaning tabs for prolonged time. The materials have been engineered to resist cleaning products and guarantee long lasting and steady quality . The container is designed to hold an upper and lower prosthesis and has an inner filter to let cleaning products and residues settle on the bottom.
excerpt: Our denture Box is a denture container and prosthesis holder that assures perfect cleaning for all kinds of prostheses and braces.

title: Bib holder chain
description: Perfecto bib holder is a practical and useful tool to hold the disposable bibs together, ready to be worn by your patients. The product is made of metal and is equipped with closure clips to help holding disposable bib together.
excerpt: Perfecto bib holder is a practical and useful tool to hold the disposable bibs together, ready to be worn by your patients.

title: Disposable non-woven caps with ties
description: The Perfecto cap with laces is a disposable cap made of soft, hypoallergenic and breathable Nonwoven Fabric. The product is in one size and is fitted with practical laces.
excerpt: The Perfecto cap with laces is a disposable cap made of soft, hypoallergenic and breathable Nonwoven Fabric.

title: Sterilization Pouches
description: For sterilizing, Dispotech produces self-sealing pouches. They are available in several sizes and made in paper-film with a transparent side. These materials make our sterilization pouches safe and resistant to over-exposure to steam when put in an autoclave, thus making the whole. Sterilization pouches are meant to contain single medical tools in order to maintain their sterility and protect them from dust and environment.
excerpt: For sterilizing, Dispotech produces self-sealing pouches.

title: Sterilization rolls
description: Perfecto sterilization rolls are produced in blue polyester/polypropylene film. Due to the heavy paper they are made of, sterilization rolls provide reliable performances and high quality.
excerpt: Perfecto sterilization rolls are produced in blue polyester/polypropylene film.

title: Disposable chair cover
description: Perfecto cahir covers are disposable chair covers for the dental and medical practices. Our chair covers are made in soft polypropylene TNT, non allergenic and transpiring. The set comes in 2 pieces: 1 back cover and 1 seat cover, weight 35 g / m2. The covers are universal in size, adapts to all chair models, thanks to its elastic edging and laces guaranteeing full adaptability. Disposable chair covers are highly hygienic and easy to dispose of, their application is quick and guarantees a perfect protection and the maximum comfort.
excerpt: Perfecto cahir covers are disposable chair covers for the dental and medical practices.

title: Decontaminating mat
description: Perfecto decontamination mat is a type of decontamination mat equipped with a bacteriostatic and bactericidal agent. Decontaminating mat for your practice, consists of thirty numbered sheets and a practical adhesive to secure it to the floor. It contains 30 tears each.
excerpt: Perfecto decontamination mat is a type of decontamination mat equipped with a bacteriostatic and bactericidal agent.

title: Visitor gown (Non sterile)
description: Perfecto disposable gowns ensure maximum security and absorbency, while providing complete coverage for doctors as well as for patients. As a matter of fact, they are part of an overall infection-control strategy: Firstly, they protect the wearer from the spread of infection or illness if he/she comes in contact with potentially infectious liquid or solid material. On the other hand disposable gowns prevent the wearer from transferring microorganisms that could harm the patients, especially those with weakened immune systems.
excerpt: Perfecto disposable gowns ensure maximum security and absorbency, while providing complete coverage for doctors as well as for patients.

title: Surgical gown (Sterile)
description: Perfecto surgical gowns are designed to protect professionals during most procedures, either with high and low risk of infection and penetration by liquids. Due to the material they are made of 45g/m2 SMS. These disposable surgeon gowns are an adequate protection for all operators as they are: – Breathable – Comfortable to wear – Ergonomic – operators can move freely during surgery – Water repellent – they ensure low particle release rates – Suitable for various types of operations
excerpt: Perfecto surgical gowns are designed to protect professionals during most procedures, either with high and low risk of infection and penetration by liquids.

title: Cutanplast Fast
description: CUTANPLAST FAST® is a gelatin product of animal origin that, thanks to its particular structure, is able to be used dry and quickly absorb a large quantity of liquids. This product is able to control and stop most of the arterial and venous bleeding, difficult to manage with traditional hemostasis methods. The CUTANPLAST FAST product absorbs in the first minute an amount of liquid equal to 60 times of its own weight.
excerpt: CUTANPLAST FAST® is a gelatin product of animal origin that, thanks to its particular structure, is able to be used dry and quickly absorb a large quantity...

title: Cutanplast- Haemostatic Sponge
description: Cutanplast is a gelatin haemostatic sponge (from pigs) in cubes with a rapid haemostatic effect, disposable and fully reabsorbed. Ideal for haemostasis in post extraction and in cases where bleeding has to be controlled. Cutanplast can be cut and shaped to meet the operator's needs and guarantees a fast, effective haemostatic effect. Its soft and malleable material makes it easy to fit the sponge into the desired area, offering a comfortable and quick relief to the patient. We can sum up the feature of the Cutanplast dental haemostatic sponge as follows: – Non-toxic – Neutral pH – It absorbs blood corresponding to approximately 50 times its own weight – Reduces the time of the surgical intervention – Stops the hemorrhage – Easy to use and to be disposed of – It can be reduced in size to any desired format
excerpt: Cutanplast is a gelatin haemostatic sponge (from pigs) in cubes with a rapid haemostatic effect, disposable and fully reabsorbed.

title: Instant ice pack
description: Dispotech has invented and patented the disposable dental ice packs in TNT, instant dental ice packs soft to the touch. PERFECTO ICE guarantees intense cold that is not aggressive, so it can be used on the face. The dental ice pack reaches a temperature of -4°C from room temperature in just a few seconds. Dental ice packs are cryotherapy devices, and are the ideal solution for a sudden relief when small injuries occur or after a dental surgery because they help patients manage pain and swelling. Dental ice packs are widely used in the medical and dental sectors for application on the treated area. The product is easy to use and to store. In a nutshell, we can sum up the advantages of Dispotech’s dental ice packs as follows: – Easy to be disposed of – They reduce swelling and discomfort due to various post-operative procedures – Made in Italy
excerpt: Dispotech has invented and patented the disposable dental ice packs in TNT, instant dental ice packs soft to the touch.

title: Perfecto barrier film
description: Perfecto barrier film is a protective adhesive film, with a 1,200 tear-off roll supplied in a practical dispenser. It is ideal for surface protection and leaves no residue after removal.
excerpt: Perfecto barrier film is a protective adhesive film, with a 1,200 tear-off roll supplied in a practical dispenser.

title: Sterilization drape
description: Perfecto drape line has been enriched with a line of disposable sterile drapes. Made by coupling TNT and PE, they ensure excellent absorption capacity. Individually packaged, they allow maximum safety and degree of sterility for the user.
excerpt: Perfecto drape line has been enriched with a line of disposable sterile drapes.

title: Dispo gel
description: Dispo Gel is a kind of hot and cold gel pack designed and produced by Dispotech, which is completely atoxic and suitable also for medical use. This gel pack can be used for two kinds of therapy: if put in the microwave or in boiling water, it is suitable for heat therapy; otherwise, if you put it inside a freezer, you can use it for cold therapy. There is a case cover with elastic band available in store in order to avoid potential burns. It is completely flexible after freezing – Made in Italy
excerpt: Dispo Gel is a kind of hot and cold gel pack designed and produced by Dispotech, which is completely atoxic and suitable also for medical use.

title: Disposable instrument tray
description: Our trays are made with top quality polystyrene, are thick and has a reinforced edge to withstand blows and dents. Our dental and medical instruments disposable trays are perfect for standing instruments and materials on; they are divided into smaller compartments to give each tool its place. In addition, the trays can be stacked to save space dental and medical trays, thanks to their disposable use, guarantee the highest hygiene.
excerpt: Our trays are made with top quality polystyrene, are thick and has a reinforced edge to withstand blows and dents.

title: Cromatic
description: Dustless and gluten free alginate for dental impressions with a phased chromatic indicator.
